source.name: Fybertech 4chan Archive
source.short-desc: Fybertech has one of the largest collections of 2008-2014 4chan threads, outside of the fallen Chanarchive and the modern 4archive
source.capture: WARC crawl of 631 individual thread pages (2008-2014). The item ships the same crawl twice: loose WARCs under 2015-02-16-WARC/, and fybertech-2015-02-16.7z containing them. Only the loose set is used.

prepare.name: stage the loose WARCs (skips the redundant .7z of the same data)
prepare.run: mkdir -p extracted && if [ -d source/fybertech/2015-02-16-WARC ]; then (cp -al source/fybertech/2015-02-16-WARC/*.warc.gz extracted/ 2>/dev/null || cp -a source/fybertech/2015-02-16-WARC/*.warc.gz extracted/); elif ! ls extracted/*.warc.gz >/dev/null 2>&1; then 7z x -aos -o./extracted source/fybertech/fybertech-2015-02-16.7z; fi

prepare.name: extract captured HTML from the WARCs
